value.rationale: An all-parameter coefficientwise enumeration of every shattered support is a natural exact model-theoretic incidence invariant, strictly finer than the known VC-dimension bound. It identifies a sharp minimal asymmetric board (2×4), full structural patterns, and support multiplicities for all sizes, supplying quantitative information unavailable from homogeneous Hamming dimension alone.
